item_short_desc: Rothco's Chow Kit is an essential tool for any camping or backpacking adventure. This convenient 3-piece set includes a stainless steel knife, an electroplated steel fork, and a spoon, providing all the utensils you need for outdoor dining. The locking mechanism ensures that the knife, fork, and spoon stay securely in place during use, adding an extra layer of safety and functionality. The compact design allows for easy storage and transport, with a durable vinyl case to keep the utensils organized and protected.
